title: khatijaliya26/Invoice-RAG-Chatbot
summary: 该项目是一个交互式的发票问答聊天机器人，利用Docling、检索增强生成（RAG）、Sentence Transformers、FAISS和Llama 3.2算法，通过Gradio界面实现发票处理、摘要和基于源头的响应。核心技术包括模型训练、向量索引和推理，适用于发票处理和问答系统。
description: An interactive invoice question-answering chatbot using Docling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Sentence Transformers, FAISS and Llama 3.2, with a Gradio interface for invoice processing, summarization and source-grounded responses.
